manualSetup.title: Allow keyboard-event access
manualSetup.description: Keycount needs raw keyboard-event access to measure typing speed across applications. The input group can read keyboard events, so only run this for a plugin you trust. Keycount uses event timing and press count only; it does not save or send typed text.

commands.description: Adds your current user to Linux's input group, allowing Keycount to read keyboard press events from /dev/input.

manualSetup.restartRequired: Log out and sign in again (or reboot) before opening Keycount; Linux applies new group membership only to a new login session.
